purpose: evaluation_only; never use these labels for adaptation
time_policy: reference_time >= all eligible support/train and support/validation label availability; full source SQL window observed
overlap_policy: task + anchor + observation + original window semantics; exclude all train/validation support and all original QA instances
label_policy: actual executed scalar; preserve source SQL aggregates, thresholds, boundaries and native empty-set behavior; reject undefined
population: diagnostic candidates, not a random population sample
